productionIncident.duplicatePattern: Three Genetics topic identities were each repeated across five lesson positions.
productionIncident.userVisibleFailure: The package ZIP action remained disabled as Needs attention even though physical export verification passed.

rootCauses.finding: Normal lesson synthesis repeatedly rejected usable knowledge because the small model was also required to author compiler-owned rich surfaces.
rootCauses.fix: The lesson-kernel-synthesis route emits a compact fact ledger, freezes admitted facts, projects downstream surfaces deterministically, and decides retry after projection.

rootCauses.finding: The public continuation parser did not recognize the production prompt's Existing lessons / Generate ONLY Lessons boundary, so prior titles were absent from the model request.
rootCauses.fix: The parser accepts the production boundary and continuation calls retain the course-map task family.

rootCauses.finding: Continuation output was appended without a normalized identity admission step.
rootCauses.fix: Candidates duplicate against existing or same-batch lesson identities are rejected, accepted lessons are rebased, and rejected topics are supplied to the next bounded attempt.

rootCauses.finding: A pedagogical review blocker disabled a physically valid archive and trapped the user's work in the browser.
rootCauses.fix: Publish readiness remains blocked, while a finished archive with passed/warning export verification and zero failures exposes Download draft ZIP with blocked readiness preserved inside.

rootCauses.finding: V0.16.61-V0.16.63 receipts persisted exportChecked/exportFailed but omitted exportStatus.
rootCauses.fix: New receipts persist exportStatus and legacy receipts infer a verified status only when checked is positive and failed is zero.

rootCauses.finding: A narrow artifact-label helper imported the full compiled-language finalizer into the landing graph.
rootCauses.fix: Artifact reference logic is isolated behind a lightweight module and the compiler-finalizer stays lazy.

readiness.reason: Lesson 15 used compiler fallback after the bounded repair budget; the draft is downloadable but not represented as publish-ready.

remainingGap.quality: The exact Genetics proof is 89/B, not publish-ready; one lesson uses compiler fallback and one citation relevance finding remains.
remainingGap.model: The research adapter has not beaten base-only Scion on the frozen held-out multi-domain benchmark and remains inactive.
remainingGap.validation: Deterministic quality and archive checks do not establish factual correctness, instructor approval, accessibility conformance, classroom outcomes, or superiority to a paid frontier model.

claimBoundary: V0.16.64 proves that the unchanged public Gemma base plus the Scion compiler can recover the reproduced Genetics failure into 15 distinct lessons, finish roughly 89% faster, and return a physically verified draft ZIP without misrepresenting it as publish-ready. It does not prove adapter quality, factual correctness, human acceptance, classroom effectiveness, or paid-model parity.
